production_points.raw_text: upload.py OCR response builders and OCR service results
production_points.item_rows: company_form_mapper.py table extraction and workbench row extraction
production_points.workbench_upload: frontend multipart upload to /api/v1/upload followed by job polling

parser_behavior.excel: Reads all visible sheets up to 10 with openpyxl data_only mode, detects adjacent key/value fields and item tables, merges rows in source order, and caps total parsed rows at 5000.
parser_behavior.csv: Decodes UTF-8 BOM first with Latin-1 fallback, sniffs comma/semicolon/tab/pipe delimiters, and detects key/value, table, or mixed layouts.
parser_behavior.empty_files: Rejected with HTTP 400 or parser ValueError.
parser_behavior.legacy_xls: Rejected with: Legacy .xls is not supported. Please upload .xlsx or .csv.

classification_logic: GRN terms take precedence; supplier/vendor/purchase fields score purchase_order; customer/buyer/sales fields score sales_order; ties and no evidence return GENERAL_TABULAR/unknown.

integration.dataset_mapping: Parsed mapped_fields and item_rows are submitted unchanged to the existing workbench auto-fill endpoint.
integration.correction_learning: Existing correction memory runs after dataset mappings and before fallback aliases.
integration.master_resolver: Existing live DB resolver receives parsed customer/supplier/product/tax values.
integration.validation_export_gate: Existing WorkbenchRequest validation remains unchanged and still requires ERP IDs and critical fields.

limitations_risks: Formula cells without a cached calculated value may be empty because workbooks are opened with data_only=true.
Heuristic header detection requires at least two recognized item columns.
Legacy .xls is intentionally unsupported because xlrd is not installed.
Only the first 10 visible sheets and first 5000 non-empty rows are parsed.
